title: A coat at the ladder
text:
A coat at the rim ladder, Tue. and Thu.
The same coat at the Polytechnic gate, Fri. Asked the porter what I eat.
Bought twice the bread. Let them puzzle.
O.B. says I am imagining it. O.B. has taken to locking her door.
The columns are not safe in the house.
Moved them. Somewhere with teeth.
